hero.title: Help Center
hero.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about using {siteName}

q1.question: What is {siteName}?
q1.answer: {siteName} is a product discovery platform that helps you explore products from Chinese marketplaces such as Weidian, Taobao, and 1688. Catalog size and available product details change as listings are reviewed and updated.

q2.question: How do I create an account?
q2.answer: Click the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner. You can register with your email address. After registration, you can save favorites and track your browsing history.

q3.question: What is a purchasing agent?
q3.answer: A purchasing agent (daigou) is a service that buys products from Chinese marketplaces on your behalf and ships them internationally. Current options are listed in our purchasing-agent directory.

q4.question: Is {siteName} free to use?
q4.answer: Yes! {siteName} is completely free. We earn a small commission from purchasing agents when you buy through our links, at no extra cost to you.

q1.question: How do I find products?
q1.answer: You can browse by category or brand, use the search bar with keywords, or try our visual search feature to find products by uploading an image.

q2.question: What are QC photos?
q2.answer: QC (Quality Check) photos are real photos taken by buyers after receiving their items. They help you see the actual product quality before purchasing.

q3.question: How accurate are the prices?
q3.answer: Prices are converted from Chinese Yuan (CNY) to your selected currency. Actual prices may vary slightly due to exchange rate fluctuations.

q4.question: Can I compare products from different sellers?
q4.answer: Yes! Each product listing shows available SKUs, sizes, colors, and prices, making it easy to compare options.

q1.question: Which agents do you support?
q1.answer: We support the purchasing agents shown in our live directory. You can compare them and choose your preferred platform before using the buy button.

q2.question: How do I place an order?
q2.answer: Find a product you like, click the "Buy" button, select your preferred agent, and you'll be redirected to the agent's website to complete your purchase.

q3.question: Do you handle payments or shipping?
q3.answer: No. {siteName} is a product discovery platform only. All payments, shipping, and customer service are handled by the purchasing agent you choose.

q4.question: What if an item is out of stock?
q4.answer: Stock availability is managed by the original sellers. If an item is out of stock when you try to order through an agent, the agent will notify you and process a refund.

q1.question: How do I save my favorite products?
q1.answer: Click the heart icon on any product to add it to your favorites. You need to be logged in to use this feature.

q2.question: Can I change the display currency?
q2.answer: Yes! Use the currency selector in the header to switch between supported currencies. Prices will be automatically converted.

q3.question: How do I change the language?
q3.answer: Use the language selector in the header to switch between English, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic.

q4.question: How can I contact support?
q4.answer: You can reach us via email at {contactEmail} or join our Telegram community.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how {siteName} ("we", "us", or "our") uses cookies on our website, and your choices regarding cookies. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

essential-cookies.title: Essential Cookies
essential-cookies.content: Essential cookies are necessary for the basic functionality of our website. These cookies cannot be disabled as they are required for core features:
essential-cookies.item1: Session cookies — maintain your session while you browse our website
essential-cookies.item2: Authentication cookies — remember your login status so you stay signed in
essential-cookies.item3: Preference cookies — store your language and currency preferences

analytics-cookies.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics-cookies.content: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website. This helps us improve our services and user experience:
analytics-cookies.item1: _ga — Google Analytics cookie that distinguishes unique users (expires after 2 years)
analytics-cookies.item2: _ga_* — Google Analytics cookie used to persist session state (expires after 2 years)
analytics-cookies.item3: _gid — Google Analytics cookie that distinguishes users (expires after 24 hours)

marketing-cookies.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing-cookies.content: We currently do not use any marketing or advertising cookies. If we introduce them in the future, we will update this policy and request your consent before setting any marketing cookies.

cookie-management.title: Cookie Management
cookie-management.content: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:
cookie-management.item1: View what cookies are stored and delete them individually
cookie-management.item4: Delete all cookies when you close your browser
cookie-management.footer: Please note that disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of our website and prevent you from using certain features.

third-party-cookies.title: Third-Party Cookies
third-party-cookies.content: Some cookies on our website are set by third-party services:
third-party-cookies.item1: Google Analytics — for website traffic analysis and usage statistics
third-party-cookies.item2: Purchasing agent platforms — when you click external links, those platforms may set their own cookies
third-party-cookies.footer: We do not control third-party cookies. We recommend reviewing the cookie policies of any third-party services you interact with through our website.

data-retention.title: Data Retention
data-retention.content: Different cookies are retained for different periods:
data-retention.item1: Session cookies — deleted automatically when you close your browser
data-retention.item2: Preference cookies — retained for up to 1 year
data-retention.item3: Analytics cookies — retained for up to 2 years

your-choices.title: Your Choices
your-choices.content: Under the GDPR and CCPA, you have rights regarding the data collected through cookies:
your-choices.item1: You can opt out of analytics cookies through our cookie settings
your-choices.item2: You can configure your browser to reject non-essential cookies
your-choices.item3: You can request information about what data we have collected about you
your-choices.item4: You can request deletion of data collected through cookies by contacting us

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at: {privacyEmail}

who-we-are.title: Who We Are
who-we-are.content: {siteName} is a product discovery platform — not a store. We curate and organize thousands of products from Chinese e-commerce platforms like Weidian, Taobao, and 1688, making it easy for you to browse, compare, and find exactly what you're looking for.

our-mission.title: Our Mission
our-mission.content: Our mission is to bridge the gap between international buyers and China's vast marketplace. We believe everyone should have access to quality products at fair prices, regardless of language barriers or unfamiliarity with Chinese shopping platforms.

how-it-works.title: How It Works
how-it-works.content: {siteName} simplifies the discovery process into three simple steps:
how-it-works.step1: Discover — Browse our curated catalog of products with detailed photos, prices, and specifications

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: {siteName} is a product discovery platform — we do not ship products directly. When you purchase items through a purchasing agent, they handle all shipping and logistics. This guide explains how the shipping process typically works to help you understand what to expect.

how-shipping-works.title: How Shipping Works
how-shipping-works.content: When you buy products found on {siteName} through a purchasing agent, the shipping process generally follows these steps:
how-shipping-works.step1: Order Placement — You place an order on your purchasing agent's platform, and they buy the item from the Chinese seller on your behalf
how-shipping-works.step2: Domestic Delivery — The seller ships the item to your purchasing agent's warehouse in China (usually 2-5 days)
how-shipping-works.step3: QC & Consolidation — The agent receives, inspects, and photographs your items. You can consolidate multiple orders into one package to save on shipping
how-shipping-works.step4: International Shipping — Once you're satisfied with the QC photos, the agent ships the package to your address internationally

shipping-methods.title: Shipping Methods
shipping-methods.content: Most purchasing agents offer several international shipping options. Common methods include:
shipping-methods.method1: EMS / ePacket — Affordable postal service, typically 10-20 business days. Good balance of cost and speed
shipping-methods.method2: DHL / FedEx / UPS — Express courier services, typically 5-10 business days. Faster but more expensive
shipping-methods.method3: Sea Freight — Budget-friendly option for heavy items, typically 30-60 days. Best for large or heavy orders
shipping-methods.method4: Special Lines — Agent-specific shipping routes optimized for certain regions, varying in speed and cost

shipping-tips.title: Shipping Tips
shipping-tips.tip1: Consolidate packages — Combine multiple orders into one shipment to save on international shipping costs
shipping-tips.tip2: Check restricted items — Some products (batteries, liquids, branded goods) may have shipping restrictions depending on the destination country
shipping-tips.tip3: Consider shipping insurance — For valuable items, purchasing shipping insurance through your agent is recommended
shipping-tips.tip4: Declare accurately — Ensure your agent declares package contents and values correctly to avoid customs issues

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: {siteName} is a product discovery platform — we do not sell products or process returns. All purchases are made through third-party purchasing agents, and return/refund policies are managed entirely by those platforms. This guide explains how the return process typically works.

how-returns-work.title: How Returns Work
how-returns-work.content: Returns when buying through purchasing agents work differently from regular online shopping. There are generally two scenarios:
how-returns-work.option1: Before international shipping (QC stage) — If you're not satisfied with QC photos, you can usually request a return to the Chinese seller through your agent. This is often free or costs a small domestic shipping fee
how-returns-work.option2: After international shipping — Returns after the package has been shipped internationally are typically much more difficult and expensive, as you would need to ship the item back to China

qc-photos.title: QC Photos — Your Best Protection
qc-photos.content: Quality Check (QC) photos are your most important tool when buying through purchasing agents. When items arrive at the agent's warehouse, they take detailed photos for your review. This is your opportunity to inspect the item before it ships internationally. Always carefully review QC photos for defects, incorrect sizes, or wrong items. Returning during the QC stage is significantly easier and cheaper than after international shipping.

refund-process.title: Refund Process
refund-process.content: When a return is approved by the seller, refunds are typically credited to your purchasing agent account balance rather than your original payment method. Processing times vary by platform and seller, usually taking 3-7 business days. Each purchasing agent has its own refund policies, so check their specific terms for details on refund eligibility and timelines.
